hooks.command: "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/agents/board-up.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; if [ -z "$(find "${SWARM_JOBS:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/data/swarm}" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name ledger.md -mtime -2 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]; then echo 'SWARM BOARD: no job ledger touched in 48 h, brief skipped; search: python3 scripts/agents/bus.py --as <you> board search --global'; else SWARM_BOARD_TIMEOUT=3 python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/agents/bus.py board brief 2>/dev/null || echo 'SWARM BOARD unavailable: run scripts/agents/board-up.sh'; fi

asks=$(SWARM_BOARD_TIMEOUT=3 python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/agents/bus.py --as chief pending --global 2>/dev/null) || { echo 'SWARM BOARD unavailable: run scripts/agents/board-up.sh'; exit 0; }; printf '%s\n' "$asks" | rg '\((\d+[sm]|[0-5]h) old\)' | sed 's/^/UNANSWERED WORKER ASK (answer: bus.py --as chief reply --ref <id>): /' || true
